summary.intent: Run the full post-execute-phase loop for GSD Phase 66 (API schema cutover for IPNS publish-gate and tombstone) autonomously: verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit → ship → resolve PR reviews.
summary.outcome: Completed through commit 3 of ~8 planned steps: security audit found and fixed a real write-escalation vulnerability (T-66-E1), SDK E2E gate passed (5/5 phase-relevant tests), three focused commits landed (security fix, hardening, dead-code cleanup), and 66-SECURITY.md written with SECURED verdict. Ship, validate, and PR steps remain.

repo: Phase 66 deleted all 5 shares spec files without replacement — the reshaped shares/claim path (including T-66-E1 fix) now has zero unit coverage; Nyquist validate-phase gate must restore it.
89 sdk-e2e tests are pre-existing D-01 milestone quarantine skips (comment: 'SDK runtime stubbed mid-milestone, re-enable at phase 63-65') — confirmed on origin/main, not a phase 66 regression.

Running `pnpm api:generate` reformats openapi.json with formatting churn and also reformats migration files via prettier — revert both before committing to keep scope tight; use canonical JSON diff to verify no semantic surface change.
`api:generate` fails its final step on a pre-existing lint error in `landing/.astro/types.d.ts` (generated Astro types) — this is unrelated to phase changes and can be ignored.
The pre-commit api-client hook only blocks on actual unstaged openapi.json changes — formatting-only churn still triggers a diff and must be reverted.
The `cipherbox_test` DB uses TypeORM migrations via `migration:run`; migration was already applied (no pending migrations) before SDK E2E run.
All sibling IPNS endpoints (publish/batch/unenroll/resolve) carry `@Throttle`; the new tombstone endpoint was the only one missing it.

code.finding: T-66-E1: writeDescriptorRef was stored from dto input without checking invite.writeDescriptorRef — allowed a read-only invite to yield a write grant. Fix: gate dto.writeDescriptorRef on invite.writeDescriptorRef !== null.
upsertIpnsRecord had unused `_publicKey?` param (underscore-flagged, single caller, never read). Removed without behavior change; 174 unit tests confirm.
tombstone endpoint was missing @Throttle decorator; all siblings have it. Added to match established pattern for destructive endpoints.
rootIpnsName used loose /^k[a-z0-9]+$/ regex; sibling DTOs (resolve, tombstone) use strict k51qzi5uqu5…|bafzaa… canonical validator. Tightened to match.
Same loose IPNS regex as create-share.dto — tightened to canonical pattern for consistency.
UpdateEncryptedKeyDto barrel export was dead — the encrypted-key endpoint and service method were deleted in phase 66 but the export remained. Removed.
shares/types.ts had zero importers (only self/barrel/generated-dist); deleted as dead code.
psql helper functions lacked statement_timeout; added connect_timeout=5 and statement_timeout=5000ms to both helpers (CodeRabbit F4).

workflow: When CodeRabbit CLI streams findings progressively, check multiple times — it reported 3, then 9, then 15 total findings; triaging too early misses the tail.
Both the security auditor subagent and CodeRabbit independently flagged T-66-E1 — convergent findings from independent tools are high-confidence; divergent findings warrant deeper verification.

CodeRabbit false-positived on deleted FolderIpns entity (claimed 4 consumers still depend on it) — always verify with grep + API clean build (DI resolution at boot proves all @InjectRepository bindings resolve).
For openapi surface-change verification, use `jq -S . | md5` canonical comparison rather than visual diff — formatting churn produces large diffs that hide actual semantic identity.
Running the full rebuild chain (crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk→api) before SDK E2E is required; dist mismatch between packages causes integration-layer failures even when unit suites pass.

friction: CodeRabbit CLI first run failed with a service connection error and needed a retry — no indication of the error type until checking the output file.
api:generate reformatted openapi.json and migration files as side effects, requiring manual revert and a canonical semantic diff to confirm no real change before committing.
CodeRabbit streamed findings progressively across multiple check passes (3 → 9 → 15), making it impossible to triage in one pass.
The pre-existing landing/.astro lint error causes api:generate to exit non-zero every time, adding noise to every regeneration.
Task output files required reading via filesystem path rather than inline — several background-job result checks needed extra reads to get the actual test summary lines.
